label: thm:gauge-conformal-invariance
title: Gauge conformal invariance
html:
Let \lambda_{+}(q) and \lambda_{-}(q) be the eigenvalues of the transfer matrix T_{\gamma e}(q):

T_{\gamma e}(q)\, v_{\pm} = \lambda_{\pm}(q)\, v_{\pm}.

For any two topological partitions corresponding to emission poles n and m, the relative ratio of their eigenspaces is invariant under continuous deformations of the substrate q \to q', up to a global conformal scaling factor \alpha(q, q').

Archimedean specialisation. We move to the archimedean side of the substrate wall. We invoke real- or complex-analytic constructs: real-valued physical observables, real-analytic bounds, transcendental constants, or numerical evaluation at the substrate parameter q_0. The categorical and q-deformation identities remain valid over an abstract coefficient ring. We specialise only their archimedean realisation.
